name: Jupyter Notebook
description: JupyterLab with a minimal Python environment. Notebooks are kept in the work volume; the token is what the browser signs in with.

access.note: JupyterLab opens on a single box asking for a token. Reveal the sign-in token from the Variables tab and paste it there; the browser remembers it afterwards. Anyone holding that token can run arbitrary code and shell commands inside the container, so treat it as a root password for this deployment, not a login.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open; nothing else here changes when it does.

update.notes: Packages installed inside the container are lost on update; keep environment files in the work volume.

secrets.name: token
secrets.label: Sign-in token
secrets.description: Reveal it from the Variables tab; JupyterLab asks for it once per browser.
